description: Versioned-data export for native-port consumers (Decision-10 consumer-port corollary). The golden conformance harness is the parity oracle; this names the versioned data a port must pin + cite.

policies.description: Unequal-cardinality pairing for minimal voice leading: every pitch class of both sets must participate, so pcs of the smaller set may carry several voices (a triad moving to a seventh chord with one tone splitting). Cited in voice-leading results so downstream numbers stay reproducible across engine upgrades.
